It compiles and runs correctly, printing "Calling greet" before each greet() call.

**Summary:**
- `ast-tool find --text greet src/greeter.h` located the declaration at line 4.
- `ast-tool references`/`callers greet src` hit a genuine tool limitation: the header declaration and .cpp definition are indexed as two distinct symbols sharing the identical fully-qualified name `greet`, so no fully-qualified argument can disambiguate them — the CLI has no way to select one. I verified call sites by reading `src/main.cpp` directly (lines 4 and 5).
- Added `#include <iostream>` and a `std::cout << "Calling greet" << std::endl;` line before each of the two `greet()` calls in `src/main.cpp`.
- Verified it compiles (clang++) and runs, producing the expected output.
